loopBoundary: Read-only repository health, triage, and checkpoint previews. Commit, push, merge, history, branch, secret, permission, and alert-state mutations always remain approval-gated.
autonomousActions: read-only repository health and status checks
preview checkpoint and push plans without writing
approvalRequiredActions: merge a branch or pull request
history rewrite, reset, rebase, or force push
permission changes or repository settings changes
dismiss, resolve, or mutate security alerts

reflectionQuestions.prompt: Are the triaged items accurately assessed?
Are the recommendations and previewed save actions safe and effective?
Have all security alerts and remote-write risks been thoroughly checked?
Which repeated repository-health task can be made deterministic without adding write authority?
Can any remaining Git Guardian compatibility surface be removed without breaking callers?
